title: FlowState
description: Universal, runtime-agnostic contract for a keryx Task Manager flow (flow.json). Validates schemaVersion 1 and 2 — every v2 field is optional/additive (TM-01). Any runtime may READ and VALIDATE against this; WRITES go only through FlowService (D-02: flow.json is never hand-edited).

acChecksum.description: SHA-256 of the frozen acceptance criteria.

gates.description: Which completion gates this package opted into at creation. Absent on packages created before a gate existed, which is how a gate is added without retroactively invalidating history: an absent flag reports the gate as skipped rather than passed.

tasks.description: Written by `flow init`. When true, `flow complete` fails while any task is non-terminal.

review.description: Written by `flow init`. When true, `flow complete` fails unless the flow's latest ingested review round is clean: every finding at or above the severity floor carries a terminal disposition with the evidence that disposition requires, the round ran against the PR head, no external PR comment is unanswered, and the verifier's stats are recorded.

owner.description: Written by `flow init`. When true, `flow complete` fails the owner gate with a named reason while no owner is set, and passes it once one is. Absent on packages created before the gate existed, which report the gate `skipped` rather than `fail`.

confirmation.description: flow 299: written by `flow init --require-confirmation`, or by `flow init` when `.metaproject/tasks.config.json` has `completion.require_confirmation: true`. When true, `flow complete` fails the confirmation gate unless `--confirm-token` carries a valid, unexpired, unspent token minted by `keryx flow confirm` for this flow and its current criteria checksum. Absent on every other flow, which reports the gate `skipped`.

owner.description: The human accountable for this flow, or absent if one was never set. Never inferred: only ever written by an explicit `--owner` on `flow init` or `flow owner set`, so `basis` is always `stated`.

signatures.description: Append-only signing record for `flow ac confirm` and a passing `flow complete`. Absent means never signed under this field's existence.

completionAttempts.description: flow 291: append-only record of every `flow complete` attempt's gate outcomes — every gate evaluated, passing, failing and skipped alike — written on every attempt from now on, pass or fail. Absent means no attempt has been recorded under this field's existence (including every flow.json written before it existed).

acConfirmed.description: Per-AC confirmation records keyed by AC id (e.g. AC1).

flowTask.description: A flow task. v1 requires id/title/kind/status; all other fields are v2 additive (optional).

dependsOn.description: v2: task ids this task depends on.

attempts.description: v2: append-only attempt log (harness appends; Task Manager owns retry policy).

disposition.description: v2: terminal outcome when status is done (distinct from status).

dispositionReason.description: Why the task ended this way. Required in practice for `skipped`: the task gate treats an unreasoned skip as non-terminal, because a skip nobody has to justify is a one-flag bypass of the gate.

acRefs.description: v2: AC ids this task addresses.

budget.description: v2: per-task budget (values OPEN in TM-01).

origin.description: v2: who wrote this row. `scaffold` marks a task generated by `flow init`. Absent means operator-authored, or written before this field existed — absence is never read as `scaffold`.

runLink.description: v2: harness run linkage. Set by the Task Manager only; harness is read-only here.

identity.description: flow 289: a claim about who is behind a value, and how it was obtained — never a proof. `basis` is `stated` (given explicitly by a flag or environment variable), `derived` (read from something like the local git configuration; NEVER promoted to stated), or `unknown` (nothing was available; `value` is then null).

source.description: Exactly where this value came from, or why there is none.

flowSignature.description: flow 289: one append-only signature on an AC confirmation or a passing completion. Never mutated once written.

criterion.description: The AC id signed. Present only for kind ac-confirm.

acChecksum.description: The acceptance-criteria checksum in force at signing time.

headCommit.description: The commit the completion gates evaluated, when known. Present only for kind complete.

confirmation.description: flow 299: present only on a `complete` signature whose flow required a confirmation token. Records that an interactive confirmation step ran within the token's TTL for this criteria checksum — not who ran it. `identity` beside it is unchanged.

tokenRef.description: A prefix of the stored token hash. Never the token.

completionAttempt.description: flow 291: one `flow complete` attempt, on the record — every gate it evaluated, whether the attempt passed overall, and the AC checksum in force. Never mutated once written.

acChecksum.description: The acceptance-criteria checksum in force when this attempt ran.

gateOutcome.description: flow 291: the outcome of one gate `flow complete` evaluated during one attempt.
